messages:
Ana: Dropping two quick variants for the billing dashboard: compact project spend cards vs detailed invoice ledger. Which should be the default view on login?
Devon: Compact by default for PLG traffic. Ledger as an "expand" or second tab to avoid heavy initial API calls.
Sasha: Tech note: ledger requires per-line fetches. We can lazy-load lines on expand (GET /billing/{org}/invoices/{id}/lines) and add ETag for rollup caching.
Matt: Finance/support want an obvious Export area. Primary CTA: "Save as PDF". Secondary: "Export CSV". Right-align near invoice title.
Jordan: Telemetry shows users switch org/project a lot. Surface the scope toggle (top chip) but fallback to left rail on narrow screens. Ensure aria-labels and keyboard focus order.
Ana: UX detail: show aggregate tokens + USD estimate collapsed, with chevron to expand breakdown (in/out tokens). Default collapsed reduces noise.
Sasha: Accessibility nit: token chips at 14px fail contrast. Increase contrast or use outlined chips. Add aria-pressed states for toggles and aria-live for export job status.
Devon: Mobile: summary-first, ledger opens full-screen drawer. Keep tables off small screens. PDF generation should always include legal footer even if UI collapses it.
Matt: Visual: when expanded highlight top cost row with subtle border and tooltip "Top cost driver". Add micro-sparklines for trends.
Ana: Action items: I'll update Figma with top-chip + left-rail fallback and compact + ledger variants. Sasha to spec lazy endpoint and ETag TTL. Jordan to draft telemetry events (billing.summary.expanded, billing.ledger.download_csv). Matt finalizes CTA copy and footer behavior. Devon to validate PDF renderer for long ledgers.
